decisions.reason: As a core bread product that remained listed after launch, it likely met a satisficing aspiration level and does not yet justify reallocating resources.
The sweet pastry survived beyond its launch year but shows no standout success, so management would likely keep it under review while using some organisational slack to tolerate uncertainty.
This farmhouse bread is close to the firm's established bakery business, and there is no clear evidence of results falling below aspiration strongly enough to trigger a drop.
The poppy seed Christmas stollen carries a gold award, indicating performance above aspiration and giving the firm a strong reason to continue it.
The premium Christmas stollen was also gold-awarded, so it likely exceeds aspiration, though its narrower premium niche makes discontinuation slightly more plausible than for E.
